note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is never pictured and nothing stands in for him: each day's work is shown by what was made (light, sky, land and sea, plants, lights in the sky, sea creatures and birds, land animals), and humankind by ordinary people of today. No garden picture, since Genesis 2 tells of the garden.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Everything that exists began when God created it; before he spoke, the earth was empty and dark, only deep waters with the spirit of God hovering over them.
ideas: A vast dark ocean at night under a black starless sky, a low mist drifting and hovering over the face of the water
A grey barren shore of bare rock and black still water under heavy cloud, with no plant or living thing anywhere, wind blowing mist over the water
A single gust of wind sweeping a long line of ripples across black still water in total darkness
The earth seen from space as a dark sphere against black space, its rim just touched by light
A deep endless sea seen from just above the surface, nothing on it in any direction
Fog over a black lake at night with no shore in sight
A bird hovering with spread wings just above dark waves at night
An empty dark stage before a performance, one breath of air stirring the curtain
A blank canvas on an easel in a dark room
A craftsman's bare workbench in a dark workshop before any work begins

sections.meaning: God speaks and light breaks into the darkness; he separates the light from the darkness, names day and night, and the days begin.
ideas: A blaze of light breaks through a gap in black clouds and pours down on the dark sea, lighting a wide circle of water
One sky over the sea split in two: night with stars on one side, bright morning on the other
The first edge of sunrise appears on the rim of a dark ocean, the sky above still black with stars
A single shaft of light piercing the darkness of a deep cave
Sunlight streaming across a dark valley as the sun clears a mountain ridge
A child pulling open the curtains to flood a dark bedroom with morning light
A hand switching on a light in a pitch-dark room
A candle being lit in a dark room
A landscape caught half in night and half in day
A lighthouse beam cutting through the night

sections.meaning: God makes a vault, the sky, opening a space between the waters above and the waters below.
ideas: A calm sea below and a high ceiling of grey rain clouds above, with a wide band of clear bright air between them
A vast blue dome of sky arching over the open ocean, high white clouds far above the waves
Mist lifting off a lake at morning and rising into the clouds, clear air opening between
Rain falling from a far cloud deck at sea while the air in front is bright
A still lake mirroring the clouds, water above and water below
The view from a plane window: clouds above and below
Seen from a high cliff, the sea stretching out under a huge open sky
The sharp horizon where sea meets sky on a perfectly clear day
A tent being raised over a camp, making room under it
A rainbow arching over the sea

sections.meaning: God gathers the seas into their place and brings the dry land up out of them.
ideas: Seen from high above, green and brown land rising out of the deep blue sea, white waves along its edge
At low tide the sea drawn back from a wide stretch of shining sand and dark rocks, dry land appearing
A sandbar island emerging as the tide goes out
A tall rocky cliff standing firm as waves break below
A river delta from above, land and water interlaced
A mountain range rising above a sea of cloud
Water draining off a field after a flood, leaving dry ground
A new island rising steaming out of the ocean
A child on a beach watching the tide go out
A harbour wall holding back the sea

sections.meaning: At God's word the bare earth bursts into green life, and every plant and fruit tree carries its own seed to make more of its kind.
ideas: Close low view of countless green shoots breaking up through dark bare soil in morning light
A valley of bare brown earth turning green with new grass and wildflowers
A ripe peach cut in half showing its stone, lying in the grass under its tree heavy with peaches
A young oak seedling sprouting from an acorn on the forest floor beneath a great oak
A dandelion clock full of seeds
A sunflower head packed with seeds
A wheat field heavy with grain
A gardener's hands opening a seed pod
A split pomegranate full of seeds
A meadow of grasses with seed heads and wildflowers

sections.meaning: God sets the sun, moon and stars in the sky to give light to the earth, to govern day and night, and to mark out our days, seasons and years.
ideas: At twilight over a wide plain, the sun setting on one side and the full moon rising on the other
A farmer at dusk looking up at the big harvest moon over his ripe field
A clear night sky over a still mountain lake: bright full moon and countless stars
A full moon laying a road of light on a calm sea under the Milky Way
A sailor at the wheel at night steering by the stars
Geese flying across a harvest moon
A grandfather and child on a hill watching the first sunrise of the year
Star trails wheeling over a mountain
The noon sun blazing over a wheat field
Sunrise flooding a valley with light

sections.meaning: God fills the empty waters and sky with swarms of living creatures and great sea creatures, and blesses them to multiply.
ideas: A half-above, half-below-water view: seabirds wheel in the sky above while below a great whale glides among swarming silver fish
A humpback whale breaching out of a sea alive with fish while seabirds dive around it
A mother whale and her calf swimming side by side in deep blue water
A cliff colony crowded with thousands of seabirds and their chicks
A huge shoal of fish swirling in a ball
A coral reef teeming with bright fish
A sky filled with a vast flock of starlings
A bird's nest of newly hatched chicks with open beaks
A mother duck leading a line of ducklings across a pond
A child in an aquarium tunnel looking up at a whale shark

sections.meaning: God makes the land teem with every kind of animal, tame and wild, great and small.
ideas: A watering hole at golden afternoon where elephants, zebras, giraffes and antelope drink together
A green meadow where horses and cattle graze by a fence while a deer and a fox look out from the forest edge and a lizard basks on a stone
A herd of wild horses galloping across a plain
Bison grazing on a wide prairie
A farmyard with cows, sheep, goats and chickens
A forest floor with a hedgehog, a beetle and a snail
A mountain valley with deer, a bear and birds
A child kneeling to watch a beetle on a leaf
A family watching a herd from a safari truck
Animal tracks of many kinds crossing in the mud by a river

sections.meaning: God makes humankind, male and female, in his own image, blesses them, and gives them the charge to fill the earth and rule over it.
ideas: A young man and woman, hand in hand, on a hilltop at sunrise, looking out over a wide valley full of fields, rivers and herds
A husband and wife walk side by side across a wide meadow at morning, horses grazing calmly round them
A young couple working a field together, he turning the soil and she planting, their baby in a basket in the shade
Three generations of a family plant young trees together on a bare hillside
A rancher on horseback guiding a great herd across a plain
A falconer with a hawk on his glove
A crowd of faces of every age and colour
Parents lifting their laughing baby high in a field at dawn
A ranger releasing a sea turtle into the sea
A man and woman planting a tree together

sections.meaning: God gives the seed plants and fruit of the earth as food for people, and every green plant to every animal: he provides for all.
ideas: A girl picks a ripe plum from a low branch while a horse grazes in the long grass beside her
A family picks berries from a hedge while small birds eat berries from the same bushes
A family harvest with baskets of fruit and grain, deer grazing at the field edge
A table spread with bread, fruit and grain
A cow grazing in a lush meadow
Birds eating seeds from tall grasses
A farmer pouring grain into his open hand
A rabbit nibbling clover beside a vegetable garden
Hands holding a heap of seeds
A wheat harvest at sunset

sections.meaning: God looks on everything he has made, all of it together, and it is very good.
ideas: A sweeping view at golden evening over sea, river, green hills, forest, herds and birds: the whole world in peace
The earth seen from space, blue and white and beautiful, the sun rising on its rim
Mountains, a lake and wildflower meadows with deer at the shore and birds above, in perfect light
A coastline at sunset with whales spouting, birds and green hills
A family on a hill at sunset looking over a beautiful valley
The evening sky glowing over a quiet valley
A painter stepping back from a finished canvas
A garden at peace
A father looking at his sleeping newborn
A rainbow over the land

candidates.principle: In the beginning, before light, the earth was empty and dark, and the spirit of God hovered over the waters.
candidates.shows: A vast dark ocean at night under a black sky, low mist hovering over the face of the water.
candidates.prompt: A vast, empty, dark ocean at night stretching to the horizon in every direction under a black sky with no stars. A low, pale mist drifts and hovers just above the face of the deep water, moving in the wind. Faint cold blue light shows the swell of the waves and the moving mist. No land, no boat, nothing else anywhere.

candidates.principle: In the beginning, before light, the earth was empty and dark, and the spirit of God hovered over the waters.
candidates.shows: A grey barren shore of bare rock and still black water under heavy cloud, with no living thing, wind blowing mist over the water.
candidates.prompt: A desolate, empty shore of bare grey rock beside still black water under a heavy, dark sky, in the dim grey before any light. There is no plant, no moss, no bird, no living thing anywhere. A breath of wind blows a thin veil of mist low across the face of the water. Bleak, silent and empty.

candidates.principle: God said, Let there be light, and there was light; he separated the light from the darkness.
candidates.shows: A blaze of light breaks through a gap in black clouds and pours down on the dark sea.
candidates.prompt: A dark ocean under thick black clouds. In the upper middle of the sky the clouds have just broken open and a brilliant blaze of white-gold light pours down through the gap in wide shafts, lighting a broad shining circle on the dark water, while the sea all round is still deep in darkness. Awe-inspiring contrast of light and dark.

candidates.principle: God said, Let there be light, and there was light; he separated the light from the darkness.
candidates.shows: One sky over the sea split in two: night with stars on one side, bright morning on the other.
candidates.prompt: One wide sky over a calm ocean that is night on the left and day on the right. On the left the sky is deep dark blue with bright stars and the water below is dark. Moving right the sky turns clear and bright with soft morning light and the water shines blue. A clean, beautiful band where the night gives way to the day, high in the middle of the sky.

candidates.principle: God made the vault, the sky, separating the waters below from the waters above.
candidates.shows: A calm sea below, a high ceiling of grey rain clouds above, a wide band of clear bright air between.
candidates.prompt: A calm open sea stretches to the horizon. High above it a flat, heavy ceiling of grey rain clouds spreads across the whole top of the sky. Between the sea and the clouds is a great open space of clear, bright, luminous air, so the waters below and the clouds above are plainly held apart by the open sky. Bright daylight.

candidates.principle: God made the vault, the sky, separating the waters below from the waters above.
candidates.shows: A vast blue dome of sky arching over the open ocean, high white clouds far above the waves.
candidates.prompt: A vast, deep blue dome of sky arching over the open ocean, wide and high, seen from just above the waves. Far up in the dome float high white clouds, very far above the water. The curve of the sky meets the sea at a clear horizon. Clear midday light, a great sense of open space between the sea and the clouds.

candidates.principle: God gathered the waters into one place and the dry land appeared; he called them earth and seas.
candidates.shows: Seen from high above, green and brown land rising out of the deep blue sea, white waves along its edge.
candidates.prompt: Seen from high above, a great stretch of land rises out of the deep blue sea: green hills and brown rock running back to distant mountains, with the sea gathered beside it. A clean line of white surf runs along the long curving coast where the land and the sea meet. Clear morning light.

candidates.principle: God gathered the waters into one place and the dry land appeared; he called them earth and seas.
candidates.shows: At low tide the sea is drawn back from a wide stretch of shining sand and dark rocks, dry land appearing.
candidates.prompt: A wide shore at low tide in clear morning light: the sea has drawn far back, and a broad stretch of wet shining sand and dark rocks lies newly bare, with shallow channels of water running back toward the waves. Beyond, the gathered sea lies blue under a clear sky. Dry sand at the back of the shore.

candidates.principle: God said, Let the earth sprout vegetation, and the earth brought it out.
candidates.shows: Close low view of countless green shoots breaking up through dark bare soil in morning light.
candidates.prompt: A low close view across a field of dark, bare, freshly rained-on soil, where countless bright green shoots of new plants are breaking up through the earth and unfurling their first leaves, row after row into the distance. Soft morning light shines through the young leaves, and drops of water glisten on them.

candidates.principle: God said, Let the earth sprout vegetation, and the earth brought it out.
candidates.shows: A valley of bare brown earth turning green with new grass and wildflowers.
candidates.prompt: A wide valley in soft spring light where the land is coming to life: bare brown earth in the far distance gives way to a carpet of fresh green grass, seeding grasses and bright wildflowers flowing across the near slopes, with young trees putting out their first leaves. Fresh, clean, abundant new growth.

candidates.principle: Plants yielding seed and trees bearing fruit with their seed in it, according to their kinds.
candidates.shows: A ripe peach cut in half showing its stone, lying in the grass under its tree heavy with peaches.
candidates.prompt: In the upper part of the picture the branches of a peach tree hang heavy with ripe peaches in warm daylight. On a flat stone in the grass beneath the tree lies one ripe peach cut cleanly in half, its stone, the seed, showing plainly in the middle of the golden fruit. The cut peach is large and sharp in the middle of the frame.

candidates.principle: Plants yielding seed and trees bearing fruit with their seed in it, according to their kinds.
candidates.shows: A young oak seedling sprouting from an acorn on the forest floor beneath a great oak.
candidates.prompt: On a sunlit patch of forest floor, a tiny young oak seedling has sprouted from an acorn, its split shell still at its root and two small oak leaves opening. Behind it and above it rises the great trunk and spreading branches of the old oak it fell from, hung with more acorns. Dappled daylight.

candidates.principle: Lights in the sky to separate the day from the night and to mark set times, days and years.
candidates.shows: At twilight over a wide plain, the sun setting on one side and the full moon rising on the other.
candidates.prompt: A wide open plain at twilight under a huge clear sky. Low on the right the sun is setting in a warm golden glow. High on the left a great full moon is rising in the deepening blue sky, with the first stars beginning to show near it. Both lights are plainly in the sky at once, high above the darkening land.

candidates.principle: Lights in the sky to separate the day from the night and to mark set times, days and years.
candidates.shows: A farmer at dusk looking up at the big harvest moon over his ripe field.
candidates.prompt: At dusk, a farmer in a work jacket stands at the edge of a field of ripe golden grain ready for harvest, seen from behind, looking up at a huge full harvest moon rising over the field into a deep blue evening sky. The moon and the farmer's lifted head are high in the frame.

candidates.principle: The greater light to govern the day, the lesser light to govern the night, and the stars.
candidates.shows: A clear night sky over a still mountain lake: bright full moon and countless stars.
candidates.prompt: A clear night over a still mountain lake. A bright full moon shines high in the sky, and all round it the sky is crowded with countless stars. The moon and stars are reflected in the calm water, and dark mountain shapes ring the lake. Cool silver moonlight.

candidates.principle: The greater light to govern the day, the lesser light to govern the night, and the stars.
candidates.shows: A full moon laying a road of light on a calm sea under the Milky Way.
candidates.prompt: A calm sea at night. A bright full moon hangs above the horizon and lays a shining road of silver light across the water toward the viewer. Across the whole upper sky the Milky Way and thousands of stars blaze. Clear, peaceful and vast.

candidates.principle: Let the waters swarm with living creatures and birds fly across the sky; the great sea creatures.
candidates.shows: A half-above, half-below-water view: seabirds wheel in the sky above while below a great whale glides among swarming fish.
candidates.prompt: A split view at the surface of the open sea, half above the water and half below. In the upper part, above the waterline, flocks of white seabirds wheel and fly across a bright blue sky. Below the waterline, in clear blue water, a great whale glides through enormous swirling shoals of silver fish. The waterline runs across the middle of the picture; the whale is just under it.

candidates.principle: Let the waters swarm with living creatures and birds fly across the sky; the great sea creatures.
candidates.shows: A humpback whale breaching out of a sea alive with fish while seabirds dive around it.
candidates.prompt: A huge humpback whale bursts up out of the sea, its body arching high into the air with spray flying, in bright daylight. All round it the water boils with leaping silver fish, and dozens of seabirds wheel and dive into the sea after them. The whale and the birds fill the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: God blessed them: be fruitful and multiply, fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply.
candidates.shows: A mother whale and her calf swimming side by side in deep blue water.
candidates.prompt: Under water in clear deep blue sea, a great mother humpback whale swims slowly with her small calf close beside her, the calf's body touching her side. Sunbeams slant down through the water from the bright surface above them. Calm and tender.

candidates.principle: God blessed them: be fruitful and multiply, fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply.
candidates.shows: A cliff colony crowded with thousands of seabirds and their chicks.
candidates.prompt: A tall sea cliff in bright daylight crowded from top to bottom with thousands of nesting seabirds, every ledge packed with birds and fluffy chicks, and more birds streaming through the air round the cliff. The sea sparkles at the foot of the cliff. Life everywhere.

candidates.principle: Let the earth bring out living creatures of every kind: livestock, creeping things and wild animals.
candidates.shows: A watering hole at golden afternoon where elephants, zebras, giraffes and antelope drink together.
candidates.prompt: A wide watering hole on an open plain in warm late-afternoon light. Elephants, zebras, giraffes, antelope and wildebeest of many kinds gather and drink together at the water's edge, with acacia trees behind. Many kinds of animal side by side, peaceful.

candidates.principle: Let the earth bring out living creatures of every kind: livestock, creeping things and wild animals.
candidates.shows: A green meadow where horses and cattle graze while a deer and a fox look out from the forest edge and a lizard basks on a stone.
candidates.prompt: A green meadow in clear morning light. Horses and cattle graze in the middle of it, a deer and a fox look out from the edge of the woods behind them, rabbits sit in the grass and a lizard basks on a sunny stone. Tame animals and wild animals of every size, all in one peaceful scene.

candidates.principle: God made humankind in his image; male and female he created them, to rule over the creatures and the earth.
candidates.shows: A young man and woman, hand in hand, on a hilltop at sunrise, looking out over a valley full of fields, rivers and herds.
candidates.prompt: Seen from behind, a young man and a young woman stand side by side holding hands on a grassy hilltop at sunrise, looking out over a wide green valley below them: a winding river, fields and forests, herds of animals grazing and birds flying across the morning sky. The couple stand high in the frame against the bright sky.

candidates.principle: God made humankind in his image; male and female he created them, to rule over the creatures and the earth.
candidates.shows: A husband and wife walk side by side across a wide meadow at morning, horses grazing calmly round them.
candidates.prompt: A husband and wife in plain clothes walk side by side across a wide green meadow in fresh morning light, calm and at ease, while horses graze quietly round them and birds fly overhead. Hills and woods behind. The couple are in the middle of the frame, well above the bottom.

candidates.principle: Be fruitful and multiply, fill the earth and subdue it.
candidates.shows: A young couple working a field together, he turning the soil and she planting, their baby in a basket in the shade.
candidates.prompt: A young couple work a field together on a bright morning: the husband turns the soil with a spade and the wife kneels planting young seedlings in the new rows. Close by, in the shade of a tree at the field's edge, their baby lies in a basket, kicking happily. Green hills behind.

candidates.principle: Be fruitful and multiply, fill the earth and subdue it.
candidates.shows: Three generations of a family plant young trees together on a bare hillside.
candidates.prompt: On a sunny hillside, three generations of one family plant young trees together: a grandfather digging, a father and mother setting saplings in the ground, and children carrying more saplings up the slope. Rows of new little trees already dot the hillside behind them. Bright, hopeful daylight.

candidates.principle: I give you every seed plant and fruit tree for food, and every green plant to every animal.
candidates.shows: A girl picks a ripe plum from a low branch while a horse grazes in the long grass beside her.
candidates.prompt: In a sunny meadow a young girl reaches up and picks a ripe purple plum from the low branch of a plum tree laden with fruit, while beside her a horse grazes calmly in the long green grass. Warm afternoon light. The girl's hand and the fruit are high in the frame.

candidates.principle: I give you every seed plant and fruit tree for food, and every green plant to every animal.
candidates.shows: A family picks berries from a hedge while small birds eat berries from the same bushes.
candidates.prompt: A mother, father and two children pick ripe blackberries from a long hedge into small baskets on a sunny late-summer day, while a few small birds perch on the same bushes eating berries beside them. Green fields behind. The family and the birds are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: God saw everything he had made, and it was very good.
candidates.shows: A sweeping view at golden evening over sea, river, green hills, forest, herds and birds: the whole world in peace.
candidates.prompt: A sweeping view from high above of a whole beautiful world at golden evening: a shining sea, a river winding through green hills, forests, meadows of flowers with herds of animals grazing, flocks of birds crossing a glowing sky. Everything is fresh, whole and at peace, bathed in warm light.

candidates.principle: God saw everything he had made, and it was very good.
candidates.shows: The earth seen from space, blue and white and beautiful, the sun rising on its rim.
candidates.prompt: The whole earth seen from space, a beautiful blue and white planet with green and brown lands and swirling white clouds, hanging in black space scattered with stars. On its curved edge the sun is rising in a brilliant burst of light. The planet sits in the upper part of the frame.
